title: DSA: Selection & Insertion Sort
description: Sorting algorithms arrange elements in a specific order. Selection sort repeatedly finds the minimum element and moves it to the front. Insertion sort builds the sorted array one item at a time by inserting elements into their correct position. Both have O(n²) complexity.

challenges.title: Sort Big O
challenges.exercise: Print 'O(n^2)' to confirm you know the complexity of basic sorting.
